Place your image assets in this directory.

Required files:

  public/images/hero.jpg
    → Full-bleed hero background photo.
       Recommended size: 1920×1080 px minimum, landscape.
       Original: Lovable CDN asset (not redistributable).

  public/images/logo.png
    → Logo used as a CSS mask to show the gold gradient.
       Must be a white silhouette on a transparent background.
       Recommended size: 1278×542 px (original aspect ratio).
       Original: Lovable CDN asset (not redistributable).

  public/images/gallery/g1.jpg
  public/images/gallery/julia-microfone.jpg
  public/images/gallery/julia-acordeon.jpg
  public/images/gallery/g4.jpg
  public/images/gallery/julia-estudio.jpg
  public/images/gallery/g6.jpg
    → Gallery portrait photos (aspect ratio 9:16 recommended).
       Original: Lovable CDN assets (not redistributable).

PLACEHOLDER OPTION
  If you don't have the images yet, replace the src values in
  src/config/site-content.ts with URLs from a placeholder service, e.g.:
    https://placehold.co/600x1067?text=Gallery+1
